The main takeaway from our work is that
the duration of fossil-bearing intervals can be estimated as a few hundred thousand years, much shorter than previous estimates.
the Jehol Biota was deposited in less than 0.7 Ma, which is significantly shorter than the previous estimate of 1.8 Ma (Wu, et al., 2004).
the Jehol Biota is not a static assemblage of fossils but rather a time- averaged assemblage that reflects a dynamic environment and changing biotas through time.
